groups.name: Completeness
groups.description: Is the data there? Checks for missing or absent values.

types.name: NULL Check
types.description: Column IS NULL — field has no value at all
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col IS NULL

types.name: Empty String Check
types.description: Column = '' — field exists but contains nothing
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col = ''

types.name: Whitespace-Only Check
types.description: Field looks populated but contains only spaces
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(col)) = ''

types.name: Zero-Length String
types.description: LEN(col) = 0 — zero characters stored
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(col) = 0

types.name: Mandatory Field Presence
types.description: Required columns must be populated on every row
types.sql_pattern: WHERE mandatory_col IS NULL

types.name: Conditional Mandatory
types.description: If Status = 'Delivered' THEN DeliveryDate must exist
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Status='Delivered' AND DeliveryDate IS NULL

types.name: At-Least-One Check
types.description: Phone OR Mobile OR Email — at least one must be populated
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Phone IS NULL AND Mobile IS NULL AND Email IS NULL

types.name: Cross-Field Completeness
types.description: If Country = 'US' THEN State must be populated
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Country='US' AND State IS NULL

types.name: Partial Record
types.description: Row exists but only a small fraction of key fields are filled
types.sql_pattern: WHERE (CASE WHEN f1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + ...) < 3

types.name: Header Without Detail
types.description: Order record exists but has zero OrderLines
types.sql_pattern: WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Lines WHERE Lines.OrderID = Orders.OrderID)

types.name: Detail Without Header
types.description: OrderLine exists but its parent Order is missing
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN Orders ON Lines.OrderID = Orders.OrderID WHERE Orders.OrderID IS NULL

types.name: Sparse Population Rate
types.description: Column is only 12% populated — expected 100%
types.sql_pattern: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(col) / COUNT(*), 2) AS PctPopulated FROM tbl

groups.name: Uniqueness & Duplicates
groups.description: Is there exactly one record per key? No duplicate entries.

types.name: Primary Key Duplicate
types.description: Same ID appears more than once
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Composite Key Duplicate
types.description: Same combination of (CustomerID + ProductID + Date) appears twice
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY col1, col2, col3 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Natural Key Duplicate
types.description: Same email address for two different CustomerIDs
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY Email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) > 1

types.name: Full Row Duplicate
types.description: Every column in two rows is identical
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY col1,col2,...,colN HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Near-Duplicate (Fuzzy)
types.description: 'John Smith' and 'Jon Smith' — likely same person, different entry
types.sql_pattern: WHERE SOUNDEX(Name1) = SOUNDEX(Name2) AND Name1 <> Name2

types.name: Cross-Table Uniqueness
types.description: Same CustomerID in both Customers and ArchivedCustomers
types.sql_pattern: INTERSECT between two tables on key

types.name: Sequence Gap
types.description: IDs jump from 100 to 102 — is 101 missing or intentionally deleted?
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ID + 1 NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM tbl)

types.name: Sequence Duplicate
types.description: Two records share sequence number 47
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY SeqNum HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Soundex / Phonetic Match
types.description: Names that sound the same but are spelled differently
types.sql_pattern: WHERE SOUNDEX(col) = SOUNDEX(other_col)

types.name: Levenshtein Distance Match
types.description: 'ABC Corp' vs 'ABC Corp.' — same entity, different spelling
types.sql_pattern: Custom function or fuzzy match library

groups.name: Referential Integrity
groups.description: Do all relationships between tables hold? No broken links.

types.name: Foreign Key Violation
types.description: Child row references a ParentID that doesn't exist
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN parent ON child.FK = parent.PK WHERE parent.PK IS NULL

types.name: Orphaned Child Record
types.description: Parent was deleted but child rows still exist
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN parent WHERE parent.PK IS NULL

types.name: Circular Reference
types.description: A → B → C → A — creates an infinite loop in hierarchy
types.sql_pattern: Recursive CTE to detect cycles

types.name: Self-Referential Check
types.description: ParentID = ChildID on the same row
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ParentID = ChildID

types.name: Cross-Database FK
types.description: FK references a table in another database or system
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN OtherDB.dbo.Table WHERE key IS NULL

types.name: Soft-Delete FK Violation
types.description: Parent is flagged IsDeleted=1 but child rows are still active
types.sql_pattern: JOIN parent WHERE parent.IsDeleted=1 AND child.IsActive=1

types.name: Future Parent Reference
types.description: Child row references a ParentID that doesn't exist yet
types.sql_pattern: WHERE child.ParentID NOT IN (SELECT PK FROM parent)

types.name: Lookup / Code Table Violation
types.description: Status = 'PNDG' but valid values are 'PENDING','ACTIVE','CLOSED'
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Status NOT IN (SELECT Code FROM RefCodes)

types.name: Many-to-Many Bridge Integrity
types.description: Junction table row has no match on either side
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN TableA / LEFT JOIN TableB WHERE either IS NULL

groups.name: Format & Pattern
groups.description: Is the data in the right shape, structure, and format?

types.name: Email Format
types.description: Must contain @ and . in correct positions
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Email NOT LIKE '%@%.%'

types.name: Phone Number Format
types.description: 10 digits, correct separators for country

types.name: URL Format
types.description: Must start with http:// or https://
types.sql_pattern: WHERE URL NOT LIKE 'http%'

types.name: IP Address Format (IPv4)
types.description: Four octets 0–255 separated by dots

types.name: IP Address Format (IPv6)
types.description: Eight groups of four hex digits
types.sql_pattern: Regex or custom function

types.name: Credit Card Format
types.description: 16 digits, no spaces, valid issuer prefix
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(REPLACE(CardNum,' ','')) <> 16

types.name: Luhn Algorithm Check
types.description: Mathematical checksum validation on card number
types.sql_pattern: Custom scalar function applying Luhn algorithm

types.name: National ID Format (SSN)
types.description: US SSN = XXX-XX-XXXX pattern

types.name: National ID Format (NIN/UK)
types.description: UK NIN = AB123456C pattern

types.name: Passport Number Format
types.description: Country-specific letter+digit pattern
types.sql_pattern: Country-specific LIKE pattern or regex

types.name: Postal / ZIP Code Format
types.description: 5 digits (US), AA9 9AA (UK)
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Postcode NOT LIKE '[A-Z][A-Z][0-9]%' (UK)

types.name: IBAN Format
types.description: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + BBAN, 15–34 chars
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(IBAN) NOT BETWEEN 15 AND 34 OR IBAN NOT LIKE '[A-Z][A-Z]%'

types.name: BIC / SWIFT Code Format
types.description: 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(BIC) NOT IN (8,11)

types.name: Date Format Consistency
types.description: All dates in one column should be same format
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ISDATE(DateStr) = 0

types.name: Time Format
types.description: HH:MM:SS — valid hours 0-23, minutes/seconds 0-59

types.name: DateTime Format (ISO 8601)
types.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ — international standard
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ISDATE(col) = 0 or regex check

types.name: UUID / GUID Format
types.description: 8-4-4-4-12 hex groups pattern
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col NOT LIKE '[0-9A-F]%-%-%-%-%'

types.name: MAC Address Format
types.description: Six pairs of hex separated by : or -
types.sql_pattern: WHERE MAC NOT LIKE '[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:%'

types.name: Custom Regex Pattern
types.description: Field must match a business-defined regular expression
types.sql_pattern: Custom function or LIKE pattern per field

types.name: Alphanumeric Only
types.description: Product code must contain no special characters
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col LIKE '%[^A-Za-z0-9]%'

types.name: Numeric Only
types.description: Quantity field contains letters or symbols
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ISNUMERIC(col) = 0

types.name: Alpha Only
types.description: Name field contains digits or special characters
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col LIKE '%[^A-Za-z ]%'

types.name: No Leading Zeros
types.description: ID '007' — is the leading zero intentional?
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEFT(col,1) = '0' AND col <> '0'

types.name: Fixed Length
types.description: Account number must be exactly 12 characters
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(AccountNum) <> 12

types.name: Minimum Length
types.description: Password must be at least 8 characters
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(Password) < 8

types.name: Maximum Length
types.description: Description must not exceed 255 characters
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(Description) > 255

types.name: Case Format
types.description: Country code must be UPPER; name must be Title Case
types.sql_pattern: WHERE CountryCode <> UPPER(CountryCode)

types.name: Encoding / Unicode Check
types.description: Non-UTF8 or corrupted characters causing display issues
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col LIKE '%[^ -~]%' (ASCII range check)

types.name: Control Character Presence
types.description: Tab, newline, or null byte embedded in a string field
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col LIKE '%'+CHAR(9)+'%' OR col LIKE '%'+CHAR(10)+'%'

types.name: HTML Tag in Plain Text
types.description: <script> or <b> found in a name or notes field
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col LIKE '%<%>%'

types.name: SQL Injection Characters
types.description: '; DROP TABLE or UNION SELECT found in input
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col LIKE '%'';%' OR col LIKE '%UNION%SELECT%'

types.name: BOM (Byte Order Mark)
types.description: Invisible character at start of file breaking parsing
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEFT(col,1) = CHAR(239) (UTF-8 BOM)

groups.name: Range & Boundary
groups.description: Are values within acceptable numerical, date, or statistical limits?

types.name: Minimum Value Check
types.description: Value is below the allowed minimum
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Amount < 0

types.name: Maximum Value Check
types.description: Value exceeds the allowed maximum
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Amount > 1000000

types.name: Between Range Check
types.description: Value must fall within inclusive bounds
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Score NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100

types.name: Exclusive Range Check
types.description: Value must be strictly greater/less than boundary
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Age <= 0

types.name: Percentage 0–100
types.description: Percentage field cannot be negative or over 100
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Pct NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100

types.name: Latitude Range
types.description: Latitude must be between -90 and +90
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90

types.name: Longitude Range
types.description: Longitude must be between -180 and +180
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180

types.name: Age Validity
types.description: Age must be between 0 and 120 for a human
types.sql_pattern: WHERE DATEDIFF(YEAR,DOB,GETDATE()) NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 120

types.name: Year Validity
types.description: Year must be within expected historical/future range
types.sql_pattern: WHERE YEAR(col) NOT BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100

types.name: Quantity Positive
types.description: Quantity on a sale must be greater than zero
types.sql_pattern: WHERE TransType='Sale' AND Qty <= 0

types.name: Price Positive
types.description: Unit price cannot be negative
types.sql_pattern: WHERE UnitPrice < 0

types.name: Future Date Violation
types.description: OrderDate is set in the future
types.sql_pattern: WHERE OrderDate > GETDATE()

types.name: Backdated Beyond Limit
types.description: Record dated more than 7 years in the past
types.sql_pattern: WHERE OrderDate < DATEADD(YEAR,-7,GETDATE())

types.name: Statistical Outlier (3-Sigma)
types.description: Value is more than 3 standard deviations from the mean
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Amount > (SELECT AVG(Amount)+3*STDEV(Amount) FROM tbl)

types.name: Statistical Outlier (IQR)
types.description: Value below Q1-1.5*IQR or above Q3+1.5*IQR
types.sql_pattern: Use PERCENTILE_CONT in window function to find Q1/Q3

types.name: Z-Score Outlier
types.description: Z-score > 3 or < -3 indicates extreme deviation
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ABS((col - AVG_val) / STDEV_val) > 3

types.name: Ratio Outlier
types.description: Return rate is 95% of sales — statistically impossible for normal ops
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ReturnQty * 1.0 / SaleQty > 0.5

types.name: Integer Overflow Risk
types.description: Value exceeds INT or BIGINT capacity
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col > 2147483647 (INT max)

types.name: Decimal Precision Mismatch
types.description: Amount has 6 decimal places when only 2 are expected
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col <> ROUND(col, 2)

types.name: Negative Percentage
types.description: A -12% discount makes no sense in this context
types.sql_pattern: WHERE DiscountPct < 0

types.name: Zero Division Risk
types.description: Denominator column contains zero, causing division errors
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Denominator = 0 OR Denominator IS NULL

groups.name: Consistency
groups.description: Does the same fact agree with itself across fields and tables?

types.name: Date Sequence
types.description: DeliveryDate must be on or after OrderDate
types.sql_pattern: WHERE DeliveryDate < OrderDate

types.name: Header-vs-Detail Total
types.description: Order.TotalAmount does not equal SUM of OrderLines.Amount
types.sql_pattern: HAVING o.TotalAmount <> SUM(ol.Amount)

types.name: Bidirectional Relationship
types.description: If A refers to B, B must refer back to A
types.sql_pattern: JOIN both ways and check for asymmetry

types.name: Status-Date Consistency
types.description: Status='Delivered' but DeliveryDate IS NULL
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Status='Delivered' AND DeliveryDate IS NULL

types.name: Derived Field Consistency
types.description: FullName does not equal FirstName + ' ' + LastName
types.sql_pattern: WHERE FullName <> FirstName + ' ' + LastName

types.name: Aggregation Consistency
types.description: Monthly totals do not sum to the annual total
types.sql_pattern: Compare SUM(monthly) vs annual_total column

types.name: Currency Consistency
types.description: Invoice in USD but payment recorded in GBP with no conversion
types.sql_pattern: WHERE InvCurrency <> PayCurrency AND FXRate IS NULL

types.name: Cross-System Consistency
types.description: CRM CustomerName != ERP CustomerName for same customer
types.sql_pattern: JOIN on shared key WHERE names differ

types.name: Version Consistency
types.description: Version 3 exists but Version 2 is missing for same record
types.sql_pattern: Self-join or LAG to detect missing version numbers

types.name: Category-Subcategory Consistency
types.description: SubCategory does not belong to its parent Category
types.sql_pattern: JOIN ref table WHERE SubCat.ParentCat <> row.Category

types.name: Gender-Title Consistency
types.description: Title = 'Mr' but Gender = 'Female'
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Title='Mr' AND Gender='Female'

types.name: Country-Currency Consistency
types.description: CountryCode = 'UK' but Currency = 'USD' — unexpected pairing
types.sql_pattern: JOIN country-currency ref WHERE no match

types.name: Country-Postcode Consistency
types.description: Postcode format doesn't match the country field
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Country='GB' AND Postcode NOT LIKE '[A-Z]%'

types.name: Product-Supplier Consistency
types.description: Product category doesn't match what this supplier provides
types.sql_pattern: JOIN supplier-category ref WHERE no match

types.name: Approval-Status Consistency
types.description: Approved=Yes but ApproverID IS NULL
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Approved=1 AND ApproverID IS NULL

types.name: Quantity-Unit Consistency
types.description: Quantity=500,000 with UoM='Each' when product is sold by tonne
types.sql_pattern: JOIN product-uom ref WHERE UoM not valid for product

groups.name: Business Rules
groups.description: Domain-specific logic that the data must satisfy.

types.name: One Active Record Per Key
types.description: Customer has 3 active subscriptions — only 1 allowed
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 WHERE Status='Active'

types.name: Minimum Age Requirement
types.description: User is 15, product requires age 18+
types.sql_pattern: WHERE DATEDIFF(YEAR,DOB,GETDATE()) < 18

types.name: Credit Limit Breach
types.description: Order total exceeds customer's approved credit limit
types.sql_pattern: WHERE OrderAmount > Customer.CreditLimit

types.name: Inventory Cannot Go Negative
types.description: Stock on hand = -5 after allocation
types.sql_pattern: WHERE StockOnHand < 0

types.name: Discount Ceiling
types.description: Discount applied exceeds the item price
types.sql_pattern: WHERE DiscountAmount > UnitPrice * Qty

types.name: No Self-Approval
types.description: ApproverID must not equal RequesterID
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ApproverID = RequesterID

types.name: No Self-Referencing Hierarchy
types.description: ManagerID must not equal EmployeeID
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ManagerID = EmployeeID

types.name: Sequence / Workflow Order
types.description: Invoice created before Purchase Order was approved
types.sql_pattern: WHERE InvoiceDate < PO.ApprovalDate

types.name: Territory Assignment Rule
types.description: Sales rep assigned to a region they are not licensed to cover
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN territory-rep ref WHERE no match

types.name: Tenure Validation
types.description: Employee start date is before the company was founded
types.sql_pattern: WHERE StartDate < '1990-01-01'

types.name: Mandatory Approval Threshold
types.description: Any spend > $10,000 must have a named approver
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Amount > 10000 AND ApproverID IS NULL

types.name: Return Window Violation
types.description: Return submitted 400 days after purchase — outside 365-day policy
types.sql_pattern: WHERE DATEDIFF(DAY, PurchaseDate, ReturnDate) > 365

types.name: Contractual Date Compliance
types.description: Service start date is before the contract was signed
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ServiceStartDate < Contract.SignedDate

types.name: Regulatory Compliance Check
types.description: Patient age field required for medical records by regulation
types.sql_pattern: WHERE RecordType='Medical' AND PatientAge IS NULL

types.name: Tax Rule Validation
types.description: VAT applied to a zero-rated product category
types.sql_pattern: JOIN product-tax-class ref WHERE tax applied incorrectly

types.name: Shipping Restriction
types.description: Hazardous product shipped to a country where it is banned
types.sql_pattern: JOIN hazmat-country ref WHERE ship is restricted

groups.name: Reconciliation
groups.description: Does the source match the target after a load or transformation?

types.name: Row Count Match
types.description: Source has 50,000 rows but target has only 49,998
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Source; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Target

types.name: SUM Match
types.description: Source SUM(Amount) does not equal Target SUM(Amount)
types.sql_pattern: Compare SUM across source and target

types.name: AVG Match
types.description: Average order value changed unexpectedly after load
types.sql_pattern: Compare AVG across source and target

types.name: MIN / MAX Match
types.description: Maximum or minimum date changed during transformation
types.sql_pattern: Compare MIN/MAX across source and target

types.name: EXCEPT Forward
types.description: Rows in source that are NOT in target — missing rows
types.sql_pattern: SELECT key FROM Source EXCEPT SELECT key FROM Target

types.name: EXCEPT Reverse
types.description: Rows in target that are NOT in source — ghost rows
types.sql_pattern: SELECT key FROM Target EXCEPT SELECT key FROM Source

types.name: Column-Level Value Diff
types.description: Same key, different value between source and target
types.sql_pattern: JOIN on key WHERE source.col <> target.col

types.name: Checksum / Hash Comparison
types.description: CHECKSUM_AGG differs between source and target
types.sql_pattern: SELECT CHECKSUM_AGG(CHECKSUM(*)) FROM tbl

types.name: Aggregate Totals Comparison
types.description: Report total doesn't match the database total
types.sql_pattern: Direct DB query vs report metric comparison

types.name: Audit Trail Reconciliation
types.description: Audit log shows 5 deletes but target has 0 fewer rows
types.sql_pattern: Compare audit log counts vs actual row delta

types.name: Pre / Post Load Comparison
types.description: Snapshot rows before load vs after load — delta analysis
types.sql_pattern: Store pre-count in variable, compare post-load

types.name: File-vs-Database Match
types.description: Flat file had 10,000 rows, only 9,800 were loaded
types.sql_pattern: Compare file line count vs table COUNT(*)

types.name: API-vs-Database Match
types.description: API returned 200 records but only 150 persisted to DB
types.sql_pattern: Compare API response count vs DB insert count

types.name: Report-vs-Source Match
types.description: Dashboard shows £4.2M revenue; DB query shows £4.1M
types.sql_pattern: Re-query source with same logic as report calculation

types.name: Cross-Environment Match
types.description: Production row count does not match UAT for same date range
types.sql_pattern: Compare counts across linked server or exported files

groups.name: Temporal & Timeliness
groups.description: Is the data fresh, in the right time order, and without gaps?

types.name: Last Load Date Check
types.description: Table was last loaded 72 hours ago — expected daily
types.sql_pattern: WHERE MAX(LoadDate) < DATEADD(HOUR,-25,GETDATE())

types.name: Data Lag / Latency
types.description: Real-time feed is 4 hours behind schedule
types.sql_pattern: DATEDIFF(HOUR, MAX(EventTime), GETDATE()) > threshold

types.name: SLA Breach Detection
types.description: Support ticket open 3 days — SLA requires 4-hour resolution
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Status='Open' AND DATEDIFF(HOUR,CreatedDate,GETDATE()) > 4

types.name: Stale Data Detection
types.description: Reference table not updated in 18 months
types.sql_pattern: WHERE MAX(UpdatedDate) < DATEADD(MONTH,-3,GETDATE())

types.name: Time Series Gap
types.description: No data for Tuesday in a daily feed — missing day
types.sql_pattern: Sequence of expected dates vs actual dates — find missing ones

types.name: Duplicate Load Detection
types.description: Same file loaded twice — row counts doubled
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY BatchID HAVING COUNT(*) > expected_count

types.name: Out-of-Order Records
types.description: Event timestamp earlier than the previous event for same session
types.sql_pattern: LAG(EventTime) OVER (PARTITION BY SessionID ORDER BY Seq)

types.name: Record Creation Sequence
types.description: UpdatedDate is earlier than CreatedDate
types.sql_pattern: WHERE UpdatedDate < CreatedDate

types.name: Status Timeline Violation
types.description: Order went from Pending directly to Delivered, skipping Shipped
types.sql_pattern: Detect missing intermediate status in event log

types.name: Future Event in History
types.description: Event dated 5 years from now appears in a historical dataset
types.sql_pattern: WHERE EventDate > GETDATE() AND DatasetType='Historical'

types.name: Event Sequence Skip
types.description: Workflow skipped a mandatory step (e.g. no Approval before Payment)
types.sql_pattern: Pivoted event log — check for missing required step per case

groups.name: Data Type & Storage
groups.description: Is data stored in the correct type and within capacity limits?

types.name: String Stored as Number
types.description: Amount column contains 'N/A' or 'TBD' — can't be used numerically
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ISNUMERIC(Amount) = 0

types.name: Number Stored as String
types.description: '00123' — leading zeros preserved in VARCHAR, lost if cast to INT
types.sql_pattern: Check column data type in INFORMATION_SCHEMA

types.name: Date Stored as String
types.description: '32/13/2024' — invalid date accepted as text
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ISDATE(DateStr) = 0

types.name: Boolean Stored Inconsistently
types.description: Mix of 0/1, Y/N, True/False, Yes/No in same column
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col NOT IN ('0','1','Y','N')

types.name: Integer vs Decimal Mismatch
types.description: Quantity stored as FLOAT — floating point rounding errors
types.sql_pattern: Check INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS for data type

types.name: Precision / Scale Mismatch
types.description: DECIMAL(10,2) column receiving values with 4 decimal places
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col <> ROUND(col, 2)

types.name: Truncation Detection
types.description: Name loaded as 'Alexander Hamilto' — column too narrow
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(col) = MAX_COLUMN_LENGTH

types.name: Column Count Mismatch
types.description: Source file has 18 columns; target table has 20
types.sql_pattern: Compare SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS

types.name: Schema Change Detection
types.description: New column appeared in source that isn't in target yet
types.sql_pattern: EXCEPT between source and target column lists

types.name: Data Type Widening Needed
types.description: INT column receiving values > 2,147,483,647
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col > 2147483647

groups.name: Profiling
groups.description: Understand the shape and quality of data before cleansing.

types.name: Column Cardinality
types.description: How many distinct values? 2=likely boolean, 1M=likely a key
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT col) FROM tbl

types.name: Value Frequency Distribution
types.description: Top 10 most common values and their percentage
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY col ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

types.name: NULL Rate by Column
types.description: What percentage of each column is NULL
types.sql_pattern: SUM(CASE WHEN col IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*)

types.name: Length Distribution
types.description: What string lengths exist in a column — detect truncation
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY LEN(col) ORDER BY LEN(col)

types.name: Pattern Frequency Analysis
types.description: What % of values match the expected format pattern
types.sql_pattern: SUM(CASE WHEN col LIKE pattern THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*)

types.name: Data Density Over Time
types.description: Records per day/week/month — is volume consistent
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY CAST(LoadDate AS DATE) ORDER BY day

types.name: Numeric Range Profiling
types.description: Min, Max, Avg, StdDev, and percentiles for numeric columns
types.sql_pattern: SELECT MIN,MAX,AVG,STDEV from column

types.name: Uniqueness Ratio
types.description: COUNT(DISTINCT) / COUNT(*) — how unique is this column
types.sql_pattern: COUNT(DISTINCT col)*1.0 / COUNT(*)

types.name: Cross-Column Correlation
types.description: Amount and Quantity should move together — check they do
types.sql_pattern: Check correlation or ratio between two numeric columns

types.name: Column Dependency Check
types.description: If Status='Cancelled' does CancelDate always populate
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Status='Cancelled' AND CancelDate IS NULL

groups.name: Statistical & Analytical
groups.description: Advanced pattern detection using statistical methods.

types.name: Mean Shift Detection
types.description: This month average is 40% higher than 12-month average
types.sql_pattern: Compare AVG(current month) vs AVG(rolling 12 months)

types.name: Variance Anomaly
types.description: Standard deviation doubled — data distribution changed
types.sql_pattern: Compare STDEV(current) vs STDEV(historical)

types.name: Trend Break Detection
types.description: Sales trended up for 12 months then unexplained drop
types.sql_pattern: Month-over-month delta using LAG — flag large swings

types.name: Seasonality Violation
types.description: No Christmas spike in December retail data — expected uplift missing
types.sql_pattern: Compare same month year-over-year using SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR

types.name: Ratio Consistency Check
types.description: Returns are always 2–5% of sales; this month it jumped to 40%
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ReturnQty*1.0/SaleQty > 0.1

types.name: Benford's Law Check
types.description: Leading digit distribution test — used in fraud detection
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY LEFT(CAST(ABS(Amount) AS VARCHAR),1) to get leading digit distribution

types.name: Duplicate Transaction Detection
types.description: Same amount + customer + merchant within 60 seconds
types.sql_pattern: Self-join WHERE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND,t1.Time,t2.Time)) < 60 AND same key

types.name: Round Number Bias
types.description: 90% of amounts end in .00 — suggests systematic manual rounding
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Amount = ROUND(Amount,0) — check % of total

groups.name: Hierarchical & Structural
groups.description: Integrity of tree structures, parent-child, and graph relationships.

types.name: Circular Hierarchy
types.description: Node A → B → C → A — creates an infinite loop
types.sql_pattern: Recursive CTE with cycle detection

types.name: Maximum Depth Limit
types.description: Org chart has 15 levels — business rule says max 8
types.sql_pattern: Recursive CTE counting depth — flag where depth > limit

types.name: Root Node Exists
types.description: Every tree must have exactly one root (ParentID IS NULL)
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl WHERE ParentID IS NULL — expect 1

types.name: Orphaned Hierarchy Node
types.description: Node has a ParentID that doesn't exist in the same table
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN self WHERE ParentID IS NOT NULL AND parent row IS NULL

types.name: Leaf Node Validation
types.description: Leaf nodes must not have IsGroup=True
types.sql_pattern: WHERE IsGroup=1 AND NodeID NOT IN (SELECT ParentID FROM tbl WHERE ParentID IS NOT NULL)

types.name: Multiple Roots
types.description: Two rows with ParentID IS NULL — only one expected
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl WHERE ParentID IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

groups.name: Data Warehouse & SCD
groups.description: Validation specific to dimensional models and slowly changing dimensions.

types.name: SCD2 Date Range Overlap
types.description: Same business key has two rows with overlapping effective dates
types.sql_pattern: Self-join on key WHERE a.EffectiveFrom < b.EffectiveTo AND a.EffectiveTo > b.EffectiveFrom

types.name: SCD2 Date Range Gap
types.description: Gap exists between one row's ExpiryDate and next row's StartDate
types.sql_pattern: Lead/Lag to find cases where ExpiryDate <> next row EffectiveFrom

types.name: SCD2 Current Flag Uniqueness
types.description: Two rows with IsCurrent=1 for the same business key
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY BusinessKey WHERE IsCurrent=1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Surrogate Key Integrity
types.description: Surrogate key in fact table doesn't exist in any dimension
types.sql_pattern: LEFT JOIN dim WHERE dim.SK IS NULL

types.name: Fact-to-Dimension Resolution
types.description: Every FK in the fact table resolves to exactly one dimension row
types.sql_pattern: COUNT(dim.SK) <> 1 for any fact FK

types.name: Grain Violation
types.description: Two rows in a fact table for what should be one unique grain
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY all grain columns HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Degenerate Dimension Check
types.description: Invoice number in fact table duplicated unexpectedly
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY InvoiceNum HAVING COUNT(*) > expected

types.name: Late-Arriving Fact
types.description: Fact record dated before the dimension row's effective start date
types.sql_pattern: WHERE fact.Date < dim.EffectiveFrom

types.name: Early-Arriving Dimension
types.description: Dimension row updated before the source system event that triggered it
types.sql_pattern: WHERE dim.EffectiveFrom < source.EventDate

groups.name: ETL & Load Process
groups.description: Validation of the pipeline itself, not just the data it moves.

types.name: Pre-Load Row Count
types.description: Count source rows before loading — sets baseline for comparison
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Source.Table into a log table

types.name: Post-Load Row Count
types.description: Count target rows after loading — must match source count
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Target.Table — compare to pre-load baseline

types.name: Rejected Record Count
types.description: How many rows were rejected by the load? Should be zero
types.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ETL_Error_Log WHERE LoadDate = today

types.name: Transform Error Log Check
types.description: Any SSIS/ADF errors written to error table?
types.sql_pattern: SELECT * FROM ETL_Errors WHERE Resolved = 0

types.name: Load Duration Anomaly
types.description: Job ran in 3 seconds — expected 20 minutes — likely loaded nothing
types.sql_pattern: WHERE ExecutionDuration < expected_minimum_seconds

types.name: Watermark / Bookmark Validation
types.description: High-water mark incremented correctly — no rows missed or reloaded
types.sql_pattern: Compare last watermark vs MAX(source.UpdatedDate)

types.name: Duplicate Load Detection
types.description: Same file loaded twice — row count doubled
types.sql_pattern: GROUP BY SourceFile, LoadDate HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

types.name: Delta Load Completeness
types.description: Changed records captured — nothing missed since last watermark
types.sql_pattern: Compare source delta count vs target delta count

types.name: Full vs Incremental Mismatch
types.description: Full load has fewer rows than history suggests it should
types.sql_pattern: Compare full load count vs running total of incremental loads

types.name: Unexpected New Code Values
types.description: New ProductCategory arrived that isn't in the reference table
types.sql_pattern: WHERE col NOT IN (SELECT Code FROM RefTable)

groups.name: Geospatial
groups.description: Validation specific to location, coordinates, and address data.

types.name: Valid Lat-Lng Pair
types.description: Both Latitude AND Longitude must be present together
types.sql_pattern: WHERE (Lat IS NULL) <> (Lng IS NULL)

types.name: Coordinates in Ocean
types.description: A point meant to be a store is in the middle of the sea
types.sql_pattern: Geospatial intersection check against land polygon

types.name: Coordinates Outside Country
types.description: Address says UK but coordinates plot in Australia
types.sql_pattern: Geospatial intersection check between point and country boundary

types.name: Postcode-City Mismatch
types.description: Postcode SW1A 2AA listed with City = Manchester
types.sql_pattern: JOIN postcode-city reference table WHERE city does not match

types.name: Address Geocoding Failure
types.description: Address could not be geocoded — likely invalid or fictional
types.sql_pattern: WHERE GeocodingStatus = 'Failed' OR (Lat IS NULL AND Lng IS NULL)

types.name: Coordinate Precision
types.description: Lat/Lng stored to 0 decimal places — not useful for any location work
types.sql_pattern: WHERE Latitude = ROUND(Latitude, 0)

groups.name: Security & Compliance
groups.description: Sensitive data, privacy regulations, and security policy enforcement.

types.name: PII in Non-Secure Column
types.description: Full name or DOB stored in an unprotected free-text comments field
types.sql_pattern: Scan comments/notes columns for known PII patterns

types.name: Credit Card in Plain Text
types.description: CardNumber stored unencrypted in the database
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(REPLACE(CardNum,' ',''))=16 AND ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(CardNum,' ',''))=1

types.name: Password in Plain Text
types.description: Password column contains readable text instead of a hash
types.sql_pattern: WHERE LEN(Password) < 60 (bcrypt hashes are always 60+ chars)

types.name: Sensitive Data Classification
types.description: Email, DOB, NI number not tagged as PII in the data catalogue
types.sql_pattern: Purview scan — compare classified columns vs expected PII fields

types.name: GDPR Consent Flag Missing
types.description: Marketing contact record has no ConsentDate or consent is null
types.sql_pattern: WHERE MarketingList=1 AND ConsentDate IS NULL

types.name: Retention Policy Violation
types.description: Records older than 7 years that should have been deleted per policy
types.sql_pattern: WHERE CreatedDate < DATEADD(YEAR,-7,GETDATE())

types.name: Masked Data Integrity
types.description: Masked email still reveals the real domain (****@gmail.com)
types.sql_pattern: WHERE MaskedEmail LIKE '%@%' AND MaskedEmail NOT LIKE '****@****'

types.name: Data Sharing Violation
types.description: Customer data in reporting DB that wasn't within consent scope
types.sql_pattern: Compare data in report layer vs consent flags in source

groups.name: Cross-System & Integration
groups.description: Data consistency across multiple systems, APIs, and environments.

types.name: ERP vs Data Warehouse
types.description: ERP shows 500 orders today; data warehouse shows 497
types.sql_pattern: Compare counts/sums via linked server or exported extract

types.name: CRM vs Marketing Database
types.description: Lead count in CRM does not match email marketing platform
types.sql_pattern: API call or export comparison of record counts

types.name: Flat File vs Database
types.description: CSV had 10,000 rows; only 9,800 loaded to the database
types.sql_pattern: Compare file line count vs COUNT(*) in target table

types.name: API Response vs Persisted
types.description: API returned 200 records; only 150 exist in the database
types.sql_pattern: Log API response count; compare vs inserted row count

types.name: Report vs Database Source
types.description: Dashboard shows £4.2M; direct DB query shows £4.1M
types.sql_pattern: Re-run report query directly against DB to find discrepancy

types.name: Prod vs UAT Parity
types.description: Schema or data mismatch between production and test environment
types.sql_pattern: EXCEPT on schema objects or row counts between environments

types.name: Data Contract Validation
types.description: Upstream team changed a field type or removed a column without notice
types.sql_pattern: Compare INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS between expected and actual

types.name: Schema Registry Check
types.description: Kafka/Avro message doesn't match the registered schema version
types.sql_pattern: Schema registry API comparison

groups.name: Cleansing Operations
groups.description: The actual fix operations applied after validation identifies issues.

types.name: Strip Whitespace
types.description: Remove leading and trailing spaces from string fields
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET col = LTRIM(RTRIM(col))

types.name: Standardise Case
types.description: LOWER for emails, UPPER for codes, Title Case for names
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Email = LOWER(Email)

types.name: Remove Special Characters
types.description: Strip dashes, spaces, brackets from phone numbers
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Phone = REPLACE(REPLACE(Phone,'-',''),' ','')

types.name: Replace Empty with NULL
types.description: Convert empty strings to proper NULL values
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET col = NULL WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(col)) = ''

types.name: Replace NULL with Default
types.description: Fill NULLs with a business-defined default value
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Region = 'Unknown' WHERE Region IS NULL

types.name: Date String to DATE Type
types.description: Parse date strings into proper DATE columns
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET OrderDate = CONVERT(DATE, DateStr, 103)

types.name: Remove Currency Symbols
types.description: Strip $, £, commas from amount fields before numeric conversion
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Amount = REPLACE(REPLACE(Amount,'$',''),',','')

types.name: Parse First / Last Name
types.description: Split FullName into FirstName and LastName columns
types.sql_pattern: SET FirstName = LEFT(FullName, CHARINDEX(' ',FullName)-1)

types.name: Standardise Phone Format
types.description: Strip to digits only then reformat to consistent pattern
types.sql_pattern: REPLACE multiple characters then LEFT/RIGHT to reformat

types.name: Standardise Address
types.description: Apply Title Case, expand abbreviations (St → Street)
types.sql_pattern: REPLACE + INITCAP pattern or custom function

types.name: Fix Character Encoding
types.description: Replace garbled characters from encoding mismatch
types.sql_pattern: REPLACE(col, CHAR(146), '''') for common encoding issues

types.name: Correct Known Bad Values
types.description: Fix specific misspellings in categorical columns
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Category='Electronics' WHERE Category='Electrnics'

types.name: Impute Missing Values
types.description: Fill NULL with column average, median, or most frequent value
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Score = (SELECT AVG(Score) FROM tbl) WHERE Score IS NULL

types.name: Merge Duplicate Records
types.description: Survivorship rules — keep most complete, most recent record
types.sql_pattern: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY UpdatedDate DESC) — delete rn > 1

types.name: Split Combined Fields
types.description: Split '123 Main St, London' into Street and City columns
types.sql_pattern: LEFT/SUBSTRING with CHARINDEX to locate the delimiter

types.name: Resolve Fuzzy Duplicates
types.description: Match 'ABC Ltd' and 'ABC Limited' to the same entity
types.sql_pattern: SOUNDEX or Levenshtein distance function + manual review

types.name: Normalise Units of Measure
types.description: Convert all weights to KG, all distances to KM
types.sql_pattern: CASE WHEN UoM='LB' THEN Weight*0.453592 ELSE Weight END

types.name: Standardise Boolean Values
types.description: Convert Y/N, True/False, 1/0 to a single agreed standard
types.sql_pattern: CASE WHEN col IN ('Y','Yes','True','1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

types.name: Apply Business Rule Correction
types.description: Set Status='Closed' where CloseDate is populated but Status is wrong
types.sql_pattern: UPDATE tbl SET Status='Closed' WHERE CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND Status <> 'Closed'
